title: WIPEOUTVARIABLES DWG writer display-frame domain
scope: The DWG writer refuses WIPEOUTVARIABLES display-frame values outside 0 or 1 before object identity reservation. Parsing remains tolerant so unsupported source values remain observable.

normativeSource.title: Autodesk WIPEOUTVARIABLES DXF reference
normativeSource.group70: Display-image-frame flag: 0 = No frame; 1 = Display frame
normativeSource.wireMapping: LibreDWG dwg.spec maps the DWG display_frame member to BS, DXF 70.

implementation.behavior: dwgWriter15::writeWipeoutVariables refuses displayFrame > 1 before preparing common state, registering the class, or reserving/allocating the handle. DRW_WipeoutVariables::encodeDwg enforces the same domain at the body encoder boundary.

regressionControl.coverage: The generated DWG write/read path retains the valid displayFrame=1 value. Its malformed-object control separately submits displayFrame=2 with otherwise valid common state and requires refusal; an existing malformed common-state refusal remains covered.
regressionControl.fixturePolicy: The test harness generates its DWG; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
